title: Block choices are determined by their blocks
statement: Let a finite set of elements with decidable equality, a finite remaining set, and natural numbers $d$ and $t$ be given. If two choices of $t$ pairwise disjoint blocks of size $d$, drawn successively from the elements still remaining, have the same ordered list of blocks, then the choices are equal.
hypotheses_covered: A finite type of elements with decidable equality
Two choices of t disjoint blocks of size d
Equality of their ordered block lists
